title: Meta-Analysis of 30+ GARCH Extension Experiments (K414-K456)

complexity_analysis.conclusion: More parameters generally do NOT improve prediction. Success comes from information quality, not model complexity.

positive_findings.title: VRP Predictability (Behavioral Finance)
positive_findings.mechanism: VRP IS t=4.38 (passes Harvey). OOS directional: 92% low-VRP→decline, 84% high-VRP→increase. Key behavioral insight.

positive_findings.title: VRP Robustness (Non-overlapping + Bootstrap)
positive_findings.mechanism: VRP confirmed: daily DM p=0.018, bootstrap p=0.000. Monthly not sig (small sample). Robust finding.

positive_findings.title: GARCH-X with VRP in Variance Equation
positive_findings.mechanism: GARCH-X(VIX) beats GJR by 6.3% QLIKE (DM p=0.050, boot p=0.027). VRP alone not sig in variance eq.

positive_findings.title: FIGARCH (Fractionally Integrated GARCH)
positive_findings.mechanism: FIGARCH d=0.61 confirms long memory. FIARCH beats GJR by 11.7% QLIKE (DM p=0.006). GARCH beats GJR too.

positive_findings.title: Overnight vs Intraday Volatility Decomposition
positive_findings.mechanism: ON+ID decomposition: R2_OOS=20.6% vs 3.8% (single var). Overnight share=36.3%. GJR effects in decomp further boost to 28.3%.

positive_findings.title: Semivariance Cross-Asset Validation
positive_findings.mechanism: RS_neg beats RV21 in 6/8 assets (DM p<0.05 in EEM/IWM/XLE). Equity markets: RS_neg captures asymmetry. Fails for bonds/BTC.

robust_null_findings.title: Fed Rate Decision Impact on Volatility
robust_null_findings.note: All t-stats fail Harvey (t>3.0). Event-day AV t=2.42, DiD t=0.86. Fed rate changes do not sig. affect vol.

robust_null_findings.title: Taiwan Institutional Sentiment
robust_null_findings.note: All volume-based sentiment predictors fail Harvey (max t=1.66). Volume ratio has zero predictive power.

robust_null_findings.title: PRS + Jump for Taiwan Vol
robust_null_findings.note: GARCH-X(SPY) identical to GJR. VIX-based slightly better but likely ARCH LM issue with original data.

robust_null_findings.title: Taiwan Vol Prediction (Clean Data)
robust_null_findings.note: After cleaning, GJR=GARCH-X(SPY). VIX-based slightly worse. No cross-market info helps for Taiwan.

robust_null_findings.title: VIX ETP Market Impact
robust_null_findings.note: UVXY vol ratio partial r=-0.001 (t=-0.04). ETP market activity does NOT predict underlying vol.

robust_null_findings.title: Day-of-Week Volatility Effect
robust_null_findings.note: No significant day-of-week effect for most assets (SPY ANOVA p=0.77). Only TLT Monday slightly lower (t=-2.82).

robust_null_findings.title: GINN (GARCH-Informed Neural Network)
robust_null_findings.note: ALL ML variants massively worse than GJR (QLIKE 13x-183x worse). Overfitting. Neural nets fail for vol prediction.

robust_null_findings.title: VIX Term Structure Slope
robust_null_findings.note: VIX slope adds 2.4% R2_OOS but DM not significant. Directional prediction OK (71% accuracy)

robust_null_findings.title: STGARCH (Smooth Transition GARCH)
robust_null_findings.note: All 3 STGARCH variants worse than GJR OOS (9.4-11.7% higher QLIKE)

robust_null_findings.title: Bayesian MCMC GJR-GARCH
robust_null_findings.note: Bayesian estimation does NOT improve point forecasts; posterior concentrates near MLE

robust_null_findings.title: SSVS Variable Selection (ARX-GARCH)
robust_null_findings.note: All PIPs < 0.25 → no exogenous variable significantly improves mean equation

robust_null_findings.title: BMA across GARCH Family
robust_null_findings.note: BMA does NOT beat best single model (EGARCH). EGARCH slightly better but not sig. vs GJR

robust_null_findings.title: Structural Break + Adaptive GARCH
robust_null_findings.note: 20 breaks detected (ICSS). Per-regime GARCH no sig. OOS improvement.

robust_null_findings.title: GAS-t(1,1) Score-Driven Model
robust_null_findings.note: GAS-t shows good robustness (automatic outlier downweighting) but no sig QLIKE improvement

robust_null_findings.title: DCC-GARCH Portfolio Vol Forecasting
robust_null_findings.note: DCC vs CCC vs EWMA vs separate: differences tiny (1-7%). EWMA slightly best. DCC correlation dynamics insignificant for SPY-GLD.

robust_null_findings.title: GPR (Geopolitical Risk) Index
robust_null_findings.note: GPR-VIX corr=0.065 (near zero). GPR does NOT predict vol. Granger causality borderline (p=0.05 lag 1 only).

robust_null_findings.title: CBOE SKEW Index
robust_null_findings.note: SKEW adds no predictive power over VIX for vol (R2_OOS=-19% alone, vs VIX 17%). SKEW-VIX corr=-0.24.

key_conclusions: GJR-GARCH(1,1) remains a remarkably robust baseline — most alternatives with more parameters perform WORSE OOS
Only 3 approaches reliably improve on GJR: (1) GARCH-X with VIX level, (2) FIGARCH long memory, (3) semivariance decomposition
All 3 successful approaches share one trait: they add INFORMATION (options market, memory structure, asymmetry), not COMPLEXITY
Bayesian estimation, ML/neural nets, STGARCH nonlinearity, and most external variables (SKEW, GPR, sentiment) are null results
12/22 DM tests survive Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction at q=0.05 — most "significant" results are likely noise
Only 4/22 DM test statistics pass the Harvey (2016) t>3.0 threshold for multiple testing
The overnight/intraday decomposition (K451) shows the largest R2 gain (3.8% → 28.3%) but targets a different proxy than GARCH
Cross-asset validation (K453) confirms semivariance works for equity markets (6/8 assets) but fails for bonds and crypto
VRP has strong in-sample predictability (t=4.38) but marginal OOS power — classic in-sample vs OOS gap

implications_for_paper.leverage_direction: GJR leverage effect (gamma) confirmed essential — all non-asymmetric models worse
implications_for_paper.what_matters: Information source (VIX, semivariance, overnight) > model complexity (STGARCH, FIGARCH, neural nets)
implications_for_paper.parsimony: 4-parameter GJR is hard to beat; additional parameters only help if they carry NEW information
implications_for_paper.null_results_important: The 45% null result rate is itself a finding — vol forecasting is mature, incremental gains are small
implications_for_paper.fdr_warning: Multiple testing correction eliminates many "significant" results — publication bias concern
